messages:
Eva (Sales): Heads-up — customer signed NDA, wants an air-gapped on-prem POC starting next Tue. Request: single downloadable install bundle, activation workflow for locked networks, and minimal manual steps. Also asked about bandwidth-friendly upgrades and proof of signed artifacts. 1979876543
Alex M: We can do a signed bundle + offline activation token. Two flavors: one-time activation token or pre-issued license key pairs bound to a host fingerprint. Which does CISO prefer?
Eva (Sales): They prefer something that survives reboots/reinstalls (so not single-use OTP). Prefer host-bound license or re-usable token with revocation support.
Samira S: Technical: we have delta patch support but it's limited to 1) minor patch streams and 2) when delta size < 40% of full image. For air-gapped installs we can package deltas as .delta.tar.gz and ship a tiny apply tool: 
```
redwood-offline apply --delta bundle-v1.2.3.delta.tar.gz --key /opt/redwood/keys/pub.pem
```
CLI verifies sigs and applies atomically. We also include SHA256 + detached sig files.
Jordan P: Security checklist: they want signed images, full SBOM, and HSM-compatible key storage. We support external KMS/HSM but offline activation requires an activation token exchange workflow — we can adapt it to use a signed ticket that the HSM can verify.
Tom (Security): Note: if they require FIPS-certified crypto and HSM attestation we need to run a compatibility check. Default image signing currently uses RSA-4096; we can produce ECDSA-P256 if requested. For auditability we can emit an activation log that is signed and included in the offline audit artifact.
Ana (Legal): Addendum: include a clause for offline activation revocation and a documented TTL for tokens. Also verify export controls on crypto shipments in contract. I'll draft.
Eva (Sales): They also want upgrade cadence: monthly critical/security patches, quarterly feature updates. Can we promise deltas for monthly patches?
Samira S: Yes for security patches we can produce hotfix deltas within 48-72 hours of fix confirmation. Feature upgrades usually require full-image drops or larger deltas; we recommend quarterly bundles. We'll include a manifest JSON in the bundle for air-gapped sites that lists available patches. Example snippet we would provide: 
```
{
  "release": "2026.04.0",
  "channel": "security",
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "files": ["bundle.delta.tar.gz", "bundle.delta.tar.gz.sig"]
}
```
Jordan P: Firewall constraint: their environment blocks external CA lookups and restricts outbound. If they want automated verification we need the CA certificate installed in their trust store, otherwise they must run manual verification commands. Provide both options.
Samira S: Also point: if they opt into persistent local model cache, uninstall will not remove model shards by default. We can add a secure wipe option: 
```
redwood-offline uninstall --secure-wipe --zero-fill
```
This will zero model files and purge caches but increases uninstall time.
Tom (Security): The CISO insists on tamper-evident bundles and activation logs with chain-of-trust metadata. We can produce a signed provenance file and a compact audit bundle that records activation events. Need to confirm retention period.
Ana (Legal): Customer also asked for certified deletion on contract termination. Engineering: can we guarantee data erasure of local logs/models on request?
Samira S: We can support certified wipe with a signed verification token after wipe completes. Implementation: run secure-wipe, produce a signed attest (hash of wiped paths + timestamp) that we sign with our org key. That should satisfy legal reqs.
Eva (Sales): Pricing question: POC -> prod transition. They want a blunt estimate to include in procurement. What do we typically offer?
Alex M: POC: 30/60 day evaluation license for free, plus a set number of SRE support hours. Conversion: either reserved monthly GPU seats (preferred) or perpetual license + annual support. I'll send numbers over DM; not sharing in channel.
Tom (Security): One more blocker: their compliance team requires proof of reproducible builds for the images they run. If required, reproducible artifacts + provenance add 2-3 business days to delivery.
Eva (Sales): Timeline ask: they want a signed offline artifact + SBOM by EOW if possible. Feasible?
Alex M: Feasible but tight. ETA: signed bundle + SBOM baseline in 3 business days, delta pipeline enablement and HSM activation tests 7-10 days. Reproducible builds + attestation + CA import doc add 2-3 days.
Ops-bot: offline-bundle job created (#5079). Estimated completion: 72h.
Eva (Sales): Great. I'll update customer with timelines, ask for their CA cert and details about HSM model. Looping in @Ana and @Tom for signoff. Thanks team :thumbsup:
